correctness.rationale: PASS: Generator identities for M_ij and L_ij follow from telegraph flip rate u/2 (decay of sign mean u) and stable damped linear flow. An independently written SymPy moment-equation solver for mixed moments through degree four reproduces exactly M20=(1+u)/[k(k+u+u^2)], M02=u/(k+u+u^2), and both rational Kx=-6Px/(kH), Kv=-6uPv/H. For u>0, Bv,Cv>0 and d(Pv/k^2)/dk=-9-Bv/k^2-2Cv/k^3<0 with opposite endpoint signs; unique simple Kv crossover. For Px, Bx,Cx>0, leading coefficient 12-9u gives no positive root at u<=4/3 and a single simple root when u>4/3 via d(Px/k)/dk=12-9u-Cx/k^2<0. The exact variance scaling yields the stated k->infinity standardized excess kurtoses. Finite rational substitutions are corroboration, not the root-count proof.
